select ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.ASSET_CONFIG_CODE assetConfigCode, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.TAGET_SCALE tagetScale, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.BENCH_DATE benchDate, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.GEN_DATE genDate, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.CONFIG_MONTH configMonth, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.TOTAL_RATIO totalRatio, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.TOTAL_AMT totalAmt, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.CUR_PER_AMT curPerAmt from ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN LEFT JOIN ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL ON ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.ASSET_CONFIG_CODE = ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.ASSET_CONFIG_CODE where 1=1
and ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.ASSET_TYPE IN
#{item}
and ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.BENCH_DATE = to_date(#{benchDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.GEN_DATE = to_date(#{genDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT tcod.ASSET_TYPE assetType, NVL(tcod.COR_RATIO,0) corRatio FROM TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT tco INNER JOIN TACTIC_CONFIG_OPT_DETAIL tcod ON tco.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE = tcod.TACTIC_CONFIG_CODE
tco.VDATE <= to_date(#{endmonth}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND tco.EDATE > to_date(#{endmonth}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

select ASSET_CLASS.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_CLASS.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_TWO type2, ASSET_CLASS.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_THREE type3, ASSET_CLASS.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FOUR type4, ASSET_CLASS.CUSTOM_ASSET_TYPE_FIVE type5 from ASSET_CLASS

select ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.ASSET_CONFIG_CODE assetConfigCode, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.ASSET_TYPE assetType, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.TOTAL_RATIO totalRatio, ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.TOTAL_AMT totalAmt,ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL.CUR_PER_AMT curPerAmt from ASSET_CONFIG_DETAIL where ASSET_CONFIG_CODE = #{assetConfigCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.ASSET_CONFIG_CODE assetConfigCode, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.TAGET_SCALE tagetScale, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.BENCH_DATE benchDate, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.GEN_DATE genDate, ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.CONFIG_MONTH configMonth from ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN where 1=1
and ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.BENCH_DATE = to_date(#{benchDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.GEN_DATE = to_date(#{genDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and to_char(ASSET_CONFIG_PLAN.CONFIG_MONTH,'yyyy-MM') = #{configMonth}
